chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Quoting other songs: the ditties he and Tatum put into tunes
summary: Grimes says he started the habit of quoting fragments of other songs, overdid it, and critics noticed.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: They were all made up on the bandstand & we used to try to outdo each other playing little ditties from different songs and stickin'
em in and make sure that they fit.

I did, and I overdid it. Because a guy wrote me up about it and said 'he's all right, but he plays too many of those things'. But all of us was doin' it. Not only me, but I guess I did it a little more than the rest. But it was a challenge among ourselves. Then when everybody else started doin' in Ella do it all the time, Sarah Vaughan all then. Nobody said nothin' about it. And they still do it. But like I said, I probably overdid it.
